title: Solana token universe
rank_basis: Public additions ranked by observed 24-hour USD volume over distinct returned Solana pools, after identity, liquidity and coherent account-price checks. Not wash-trade-adjusted or whole-chain volume.
included: Native Solana assets and issuer-bound tokenized stocks, ETFs and other RWA with verified pool routes. Public admission requires independent coverage review.
excluded: Duplicate mint identities, ambiguous issuer mappings and candidates without a validated usable price path remain unlisted.
coverage: Market cap retains its attributed source. Volume is reported Solana pool volume. Underlying stock references are separate instruments; closed sessions and missing records are not executions.
